features.title: Field engineer
features.text: Mechanics hack and repair technology. Temporary modifications can improve a weapon's range or let armor hover above the ground.

features.title: Exocortex
features.text: An exocortex links their mind to a drone, turret or set of mines. Directing it takes actions that could otherwise go toward attacks or repairs.

review.notes: Provisional assessment of the named playtest, not the final class. Tech Core is scheduled for October 7, 2026; these entries still describe the playtest and require a separate final-rules update.

ratings.offense: 3–4 → 3–4. Provisional playtest estimate: drone, turret or mine choices change damage delivery.
ratings.defense: 3 → 3–4. Gear and exocortex choices can favor personal protection.
ratings.support: 3 → 3–4. Modifications and selected engineering options can assist allies.
ratings.utility: 4.5 → 4–5. Intelligence and technology expertise offer strong practical exploration tools.
ratings.difficulty: 4 → 4. Coordinate exocortex actions, modifications and technical options.
